title: a pointer-event sortable list can be reordered by dragging a card

interactions.name: the page's listeners work over the mirror
the drag's motion reaches the page
dropping a card reorders the list

interaction.reason: a press-move-release on ordinary content is left to the browser as text selection; no drag frame exists for a non-canvas element, so the gesture never goes landside

notes: the card styling carries the affordance signals (cursor: grab, touch-action: none, user-select: none) every real sortable sets, which is what a plane-side gesture census has to read
